requirements.display_name: Replacement automotive fuse of the specified amperage

actions.title: Switch the ignition and accessories off
actions.instruction: Turn the ignition switch to LOCK/OFF and switch off all electrical accessories.

actions.title: Locate the correct fuse and rating
actions.instruction: Use the fuse-box cover and the owner-manual fuse/circuit information to identify the suspected fuse and its specified rating.

actions.title: Remove the fuse with the fuse puller
actions.instruction: Use the fuse puller stored in the engine-compartment fuse box to remove the suspected fuse.

actions.title: Inspect the fuse and install the same rating if blown
actions.instruction: Inspect the fuse element. If it is blown, install a new fuse of the same rating.
actions.warning_text: Do not install a fuse with a higher amperage rating.

actions.title: Verify operation and stop if the fuse blows again
actions.instruction: Restore power and verify the circuit. If the same fuse blows again, stop and have the electrical system inspected by a Subaru retailer or qualified technician.
